name: sygnal
description: Sygnal's static checker in the editor: wiring bugs that fail silently (intent/model/view, EVENTS, child components, Collections) as you type, with explanations, quick fixes, completions, go to definition, code lenses and a safe rename.
author: Troy Presley <troy.presley@gmail.com>

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace the extension runs only its bundled sygnal-check, never the copy in the workspace's node_modules.

sygnal.strict.markdownDescription: Also run the strict-mode rules (canonical forms, SYG5xx), like `sygnal-check --strict`. Unset (`null`): the config file (`sygnal-check.config.json` or the `sygnal-check` key in `package.json`) decides.

enumDescriptions: Unset: the config file decides (default: warn).
sygnal.a11y.markdownDescription: Severity of the accessibility findings (SYG7xx), like `sygnal-check --a11y=error`. Unset (`null`): the config file decides.

sygnal.ignore.markdownDescription: Codes to drop entirely, e.g. `["SYG105"]`. Replaces the config file's list (not merged). Unset (`null`): the config file decides.

sygnal.paths.markdownDescription: Files, directories or globs to check, relative to the workspace folder (e.g. `["src"]`, or `["pages"]` for Vike). Replaces the config file's list. Unset (`null`): the config file decides.

sygnal.verbose.markdownDescription: Also show info findings (hints that need a judgment call), like `sygnal-check --verbose`. Unset (`null`): off.

sygnal.codeLens.markdownDescription: Show code lenses above intent keys, model keys and EVENTS selects / emits: what handles an action, what triggers it, how many emitters or listeners an EVENTS type has. Click one to see the targets in a peek view. Unset (`null`): on. An editor setting only: the config file has no such key.

enumDescriptions: Also log each check, and trace the LSP messages in the output.
Also log each message the server receives, with full message traces.
sygnal.trace.server.markdownDescription: What the language server logs to the **Sygnal** output channel (`Sygnal: Show Output`). Unset (`null`): `off`.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON --test test/unit/*.test.mts && node scripts/build.mjs && node test/smoke/run.mjs
